description: This script manages running tests with Xvfb (X virtual framebuffer) on Linux platforms, including starting/stopping Xvfb, waiting for it to initialize, and handling environment setup for test execution.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills a process by PID, ignoring errors if the process does not exist.

methods.name: get_xvfb_path
methods.description: Determines the path to the Xvfb executable based on the server directory.

methods.name: start_xvfb
methods.description: Starts a virtual X server using Xvfb and returns its process ID.

methods.name: wait_for_xvfb
methods.description: Waits for Xvfb to be fully initialized by checking with xdisplaycheck.

methods.name: run_executable
methods.description: Runs a command within an Xvfb buffer on Linux or normally on other platforms, handling environment setup and process management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and executes the test command with appropriate environment setup.
